what.title: What is Younit?
what.body1: Younit opens EFG Hermes' trading infrastructure through APIs, providing access to Egypt's stock market, real-time and historical market data, and an open-source Python SDK.
what.body2: As the first retail algorithmic trading API in Egypt and the wider MENA region, Younit enables users to automate trades, build trading apps, test strategies, backtest ideas, and work with real market data through one platform.
what.videoAlt: A short film: a single square becomes a rule, the rule sends signals down three paths, and a grid lights up as the strategy runs on its own.

how.title: How Younit Works

steps.title: Create your account
steps.body: Sign up for Younit by downloading the EFG Hermes ONE app. Once you have downloaded the app, click "Get your API key" on the Younit website and enter your username and ID to generate your API key.

steps.title: Connect to Younit
steps.body: Install the Python SDK on your computer. This lets you connect to the Egyptian stock market and use Younit through code.

steps.title: Access market data
steps.body: Use the API to access live prices, historical market data, market depth, and your portfolio. You can use this information to understand the market and build your own tools.

steps.title: Build your strategy
steps.body: Write your own trading rules or use a model to decide when to buy or sell. Your strategy could be as simple or advanced as you want.

steps.title: Test before you trade
steps.body: Use historical market data to backtest your strategy. This shows you how your idea would have performed in the past and helps you identify what works and what does not before putting real money at risk.

steps.title: Trade automatically
steps.body: Once you are ready, connect your strategy to your Younit account. Your code can then place and manage trades automatically based on the rules you created.

steps.title: Keep building
steps.body: Younit is not just for trading. You can use the infrastructure to build trading apps, analytics tools, portfolio dashboards, and other financial products.

how.closing: In simple terms: Younit gives you the tools to access the market, build an idea, test it with real data, and turn it into a working trading solution.

faq.title: FAQs
faq.sub: What Younit is, what you can build with it, and how to get started.

a: Younit is EFG Hermes' API-powered trading platform, giving developers and traders access to EFG Hermes' brokerage infrastructure through an API and Python SDK. Built around Learn, Build and Compete, it gives developers and traders the tools to access the Egyptian market, work with market data, build and test trading strategies, and execute trades through EFG Hermes.

Younit connects your code to EFG Hermes' brokerage infrastructure through an API. Once you have your API key, you can use Python SDK to access live prices, historical market data, market depth, your portfolio and order placement.
You can then develop your own trading logic, test your strategies against historical market data and, when ready, connect them to your account for live execution.

items.q: What can I build with Younit?
a: You can build your own trading applications, tools, and algorithmic trading strategies using Younit's API and Python SDK.

Whether you're creating a simple trading rule, developing a more advanced model or building something entirely new, Younit gives you the infrastructure to turn your ideas into code and connect them to the Egyptian market.
Younit is built for anyone who wants to explore, build or automate their trading experience:

list.label: Developers
list.text: Software engineers and developers who want to build their own trading applications or automate their trading strategies.

list.label: Students
list.text: University students looking to explore algorithmic trading through graduation projects or EFG-sponsored opportunities and internships.

list.label: Traders and Investors
list.text: Existing EFG Hermes clients who want to explore API-based trading and discover new ways to interact with the markets.

items.q: How do I get onboarded on Younit?
a: To get started with Younit, you first need an active EFG Hermes ONE account. Once your account is set up, you can access Younit and generate your API Key to start building and connecting your applications to EFG Hermes' trading infrastructure.

steps.text: Open an EFG Hermes ONE account.
Start building with Younit's APIs and developer tools.

items.q: Do I need an EFG Hermes ONE account to onboard on Younit?
a: Yes. You need an active EFG Hermes ONE account to onboard on Younit and access its trading APIs. Once your ONE account is set up, you can generate your API Key and start building with Younit.

items.q: What markets can I access through Younit?
a: Younit gives you access to the markets available through EFG Hermes' brokerage infrastructure, including the Egyptian Exchange (EGX) and other supported markets.
Yes. You don't need to be an expert, but a basic understanding of programming and APIs will help you get started.

items.q: Where are the docs and examples?
a: You'll find them on GitHub, linked directly from the Younit website.

items.q: Can EFG Hermes give me a strategy?
a: No. Younit provides the access, tools, APIs, data, and infrastructure you need to build and execute your own strategies. The trading strategy, decisions, and how you use these tools are entirely up to you.

Younit operates through EFG Hermes, a regulated financial services group. Trading activities are carried out through EFG Hermes' regulated brokerage infrastructure and are subject to the applicable regulatory requirements.
